messages:
sam: Quick post-AH thread to capture a few clarifications from leadership Q&A. Two asks: exact Dedicated GA cadence and where to file early customer interest. Also need owner for the migration checklist.

ana: GA target = Sept 10th. We'll open commit signups on July 20th. Pricing/terms still being finalized with finance.

carmen: I'll take beta intake coordination. Please ask customers to email sales@redwood.com with subject 'dedicated-interest' and cc me. I'll keep a weekly sheet.

leo: I'll draft the migration checklist/runbook. Will include preflight network checks, KV/LS cache tuning, and example terraform snippets. Plan to post a PR by next Tue. Example snippet I'll include:
```
# recommended runtime flags
--max-batch=200
--kv-cache-entries=100000
--idle-scale-down=90
```

tara: For public comms: confirm there will be an SLA at GA? ana: yes, a standard uptime SLA and latency SLOs; exact numbers are in review.

deploy-bot: Notice: dedicated-ga-plan updated by ana 8h ago9 changelog: "GA date + signup window added"

sam: Action items (owners):
- ana: publish GA landing + signup link by Mon (owner: ana)
- leo: migration checklist PR by Tue (owner: leo)
- carmen: weekly beta-interest digest starting next Wed (owner: carmen)
- tara/ana: confirm SLA numbers for comms (owners: tara, ana)
I'll convert to tickets and ping owners. Thanks all :thumbsup:
